question: Should ClickClack core permanently expose and support the provider-neutral managed-channel reconciliation API and its persistent external identity contract?
rationale: The patch is a coherent implementation of the paired proposal, but accepting a new durable API, database identity, and SDK surface is a product-boundary choice rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Approve the narrow core primitive
options.body: Accept the provider-neutral identity and reconcile endpoint while continuing to keep provider adapters, credentials, and workflow authority outside ClickClack.

options.title: Keep reconciliation outside core
options.body: Decline the persistent API surface and direct integrations to compose existing channel operations or an external integration layer instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow core primitive
recommendation.body: Accept the provider-neutral identity and reconcile endpoint while continuing to keep provider adapters, credentials, and workflow authority outside ClickClack.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the existing managed-channel contract and its long-term ownership; repository history should identify the relevant feature owner before final approval.
